supersession.reason: Parallel work replaced tools/trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py with tools/trigger2_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py before the predecessor audit commit landed. Preserve the predecessor as provenance/negative reasoning, but use this v2 audit for current-source decisions.

repairs_vs_removed_predecessor_source: Current branch validation requires the full v/K/E_plus/E_minus/F/T/A/sigma/projection/validity carrier rather than only minimal evidence lists.
D_resolve now explicitly requires discriminator_admissible together with discriminator_executed.
U_update requires a relation for every branch and rejects unknown relation values.
Merge requires an exact synthetic-equivalence rule and verifies matching v/K/T signatures.
Current tests add inadmissible-discriminator ordering, majority anti-collapse, merge rejection and full branch-relation coverage cases.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: U_update consumes observation.branch_relations as latent generator metadata. The current labeler validates coverage and enum values but does not compute SUPPORT/COUNTER/FALSIFY/NO_EFFECT from the synthetic task-world semantics or require a cryptographically/exactly bound deterministic derivation receipt.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.boundary: This is acceptable only as a downstream transition primitive if a separately verified generator computes branch_relations deterministically. Without that upstream proof, the training target is still generator-asserted rather than independently labeled.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Bind every transition row to exact generator source/hash plus a deterministic relation-derivation function/receipt; mutation-test that changing task-world evidence changes only the relations entailed by the formal world.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: Evidence decision_role=NONDECISIVE/DECISIVE_SUPPORT/DECISIVE_CONTRADICTION is caller supplied. D_resolve uses these roles to decide whether a unique eligible branch may resolve.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Derive decision_role from explicit proof/discriminator semantics and observed result, or require a verified deterministic proof certificate. Model/generator self-declaration cannot be the root label source.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: D_resolve now checks discriminator_executed and discriminator_admissible, but both are context booleans rather than exact execution/admission receipts. all_other_branches_explicitly_falsified is also caller supplied.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Consume or bind an exact discriminator receipt and derive all-other-branches-falsified from branch state instead of a free boolean.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: U_d_test_order ranks declared separates_branch_pairs and novel_independence_groups but does not derive pair separation from each branch's predicted test outcome. A generator can overstate discrimination utility.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Represent predicted discriminator outcome per live branch and compute separated pairs/partitions mechanically; compute novelty from evidence/dependence identities rather than an integer claim.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: Evidence deduplication keys on (evidence_id, provenance_ancestry_id, independence_group). Distinct evidence IDs in the same dependence group remain multiple E_plus/E_minus entries. Although D_resolve does not majority-count them, the latent training state still exposes correlated multiplicity and can teach a frequency shortcut.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Preserve provenance records while separately normalizing/collapsing evidence-strength contribution by dependence/causal group; add duplicated-packaging invariance tests.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: The source preserves input branch order and the current tests do not compare semantically identical episodes under branch-order/ID permutations.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Canonicalize/evaluate semantic outputs modulo branch renaming and require update/resolve/discriminator rankings to be equivariant under branch permutation.

remaining_causal_chain_gaps.finding: Current test files exist on main, but this cycle could not execute a local clone because the local container could not resolve github.com. Source/test presence therefore receives no execution credit here.
remaining_causal_chain_gaps.required_gate: Run the exact committed tests on an available admitted/free deterministic surface and bind source identity; infrastructure failure is not a scientific failure.

status_revision.old_blocker: D/E impossible because reference labelers do not exist.
status_revision.after_current_main: Labeler primitives exist and solve several structural invariants.
status_revision.current_precise_blocker: D/E positive transition labels remain non-admissible until the full chain task-world semantics -> branch relations/decision roles -> update -> discriminator receipt -> resolve is mechanically derived and source-bound, then enforced by the candidate admission gate.

external_research_updates.delta: Keep arbitrary/flipped episode-local label mappings as binder pressure; they discourage reliance on fixed semantic label priors.
Systematic variable binding/routing is mechanistically plausible under training, but positive mechanism claims remain checkpoint-specific and causal.
Do not turn the induction-head analogy in the training-scope report into a required internal mechanism; optimize behavioral/state invariants and diagnose learned circuitry afterward.
Track C symbolic-reasoning generalization through extended training and frozen OOD depth/vocabulary families; train-loss convergence is not sufficient evidence of rule learning.
An explicit abstention objective is plausible training pressure for UNKNOWN/ABSTAIN, but project-specific epistemic correctness and calibration gates remain required.

new_training_and_eval_rules: A deterministic transition function is not a reference labeler if its decisive relation labels are unconstrained caller metadata.
Reference-label provenance must form an executable chain from task-world specification to target transition, not begin at a generated class/effect field.
Keep semantic Hyperposition present from the first integrated episode while staging full D optimization late.
Do not hard-code classic induction-copy circuitry as the training target; mechanism hypotheses remain eval/research targets.
For C, store checkpoint curves for train, lexical OOD, rule-depth OOD and composition OOD so late grokking or memorization can be distinguished.
For E, measure selective risk/coverage or equivalent abstention utility in addition to raw ABSTAIN frequency so refusal suppression and epistemic restraint are not conflated.
Correlated evidence multiplicity must be an invariance test even when the deterministic resolver itself does not majority-count.
priority_order: P0 derivation-bind branch_relations and evidence decision_role to deterministic task-world semantics
P1 bind discriminator execution/admissibility and compute separation from predicted branch outcomes
P2 add dependence-group normalization plus branch-permutation/evidence-repackaging invariance tests
P3 integrate exact labeler/generator hashes and transition receipts into a gate-v2 successor
P4 only then regenerate high-coverage A/B/C/E and census trajectories into Hyperposition-native before/after rows
P5 freeze checkpoint/tokenizer/ABI/splits and run smallest FREE_ONLY pilot; accepted dataset/training/J-Space credit stays zero until its own gates
next_exact_action: Implement or review the generator-side deterministic derivation layer that produces branch_relations and decision_role from formal synthetic task-world facts/rules/observations, then bind its source/hash and discriminator receipt into a gate-v2 transition admission path; do not expand D/E positive volume before this causal label chain passes adversarial invariance tests.
